purpose: Attribute two roles or qualities to the same thing.
keywords: N / な-adjective stem + でもあり … + でもある
He is both a doctor and a writer.
This decision is both courageous and risky.
That place is both a bookstore and a café.
formation: N / な-adjective stem + でもあり … + でもある
restrictions: The two descriptions are both applicable.
mistake: This is additive, not a choice between alternatives.
